d:
Prashant kishor ke brahman-muslim phormule ko lekar bihar ki rajniti men naee charcha shuru ho gaee hai. kya PK kangres ke purane MY yani muslim-yadav samikran se aage barhkar brahman-muslim samajik samikran banane ki koshish kar rahe hain? is ranniti ke pichhe ki rajniti, kangres ke purane vot baink aur bihar ki siyasat par iske sanbhavit asar ko samjhie is khas riport men.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
